title: Il quartiere di Giulia
summary: Review + immersion: Giulia narrates her Bologna quartiere, weaving family, adjectives, and questo/quello

blocks.title: Prima di iniziare
blocks.body: This week you learned family with possessives (**mio/mia**, no article at the singular), adjectives that **agree** in gender and number, **questo/quello** for near and far, and the quartiere with **a/in/da**. Time to put it all together — Giulia's about to walk you through her Bologna.
blocks.callout: Listen for family, adjectives, and questo/quello all in one conversation.

blocks.prompt: Which is correct: 'my sister is very nice'?
options: La mia sorella è molto simpatica
blocks.explain: mia sorella has no article (plain singular family word), and simpatica agrees with the feminine subject.

blocks.prompt: Type 'that square is beautiful' in Italian — use quella.
blocks.hint: piazza is feminine singular, and it's across the way — quello agrees.
blocks.explain: *Quella piazza è bella* — quella and bella both agree with the feminine piazza.

blocks.scene: Giulia takes you on a walk through her quartiere, near Via Mazzini

lines.speaker: Giulia
lines.nl: Allora, questo è il mio quartiere, vicino a via Mazzini. Guarda quella piazza!
lines.en: So, this is my neighborhood, near Via Mazzini. Look at that square!

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: Che bella! C'è un mercato qui?
lines.en: How lovely! Is there a market here?

lines.speaker: Giulia
lines.nl: Sì, ogni mattina, in quella via a destra. Compro la frutta da un signore molto gentile.
lines.en: Yes, every morning, on that street to the right. I buy fruit from a very kind gentleman.

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: E la tua famiglia? Abita qui vicino?
lines.en: And your family? Do they live nearby?

lines.speaker: Giulia
lines.nl: Mia madre abita ancora a Parma, ma mio fratello abita qui, in centro, in un appartamento piccolo ma carino.
lines.en: My mother still lives in Parma, but my brother lives here, downtown, in a small but nice apartment.
lines.spotlight: mia madre / mio fratello — plain singular family words, no article; a Parma — cities take a.

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: E quella chiesa, lì in fondo?
lines.en: And that church, over there at the end?

lines.speaker: Giulia
lines.nl: È antica e bellissima. La domenica è piena di gente in piazza.
lines.en: It's old and beautiful. On Sundays the square is full of people.

questions.q: What does Giulia buy every morning near the piazza?

blocks.prompt: In two or three sentences, describe your own quartiere the way Giulia described hers — mention one place with questo/quello and one preposition (a/in/da).
